hero.title: Model access
hero.description: Choose exactly what Codex can do in each conversation. The bridge continues to sync everything locally; this panel controls MCP and webhooks, not tools with direct file access.
hero.defaultCopy: New recipients are blocked without the global permission.
connection.bannerCopy: You can still adjust permissions. Sending will work after the bridge reconnects.
global.title: Start new individual conversations
global.description: Allows the model to send the first message to a number that is not yet listed in the Bridge. After sending, the conversation automatically receives full access: new messages, history, and sending.
global.enabledToast: The model can now start new individual conversations.
global.enabledLive: Permission to start new conversations enabled.
global.disabledLive: Permission to start new conversations disabled.

dialog.newCopy: The model will be able to start individual conversations with any valid number provided to it, even if that number is not yet listed. After the first message, that conversation will receive full access. Unknown groups remain blocked.
